about: Gap probes: questions the docs do not answer, for calibrating a chatbot's 'the docs don't cover this' threshold. Written 2026-10-11, committed before scoring. Each was checked against the full text of all 4,877 indexed sections (2026-10-11): the topic is absent, or appears only in an unrelated sense. Two are deliberate near-misses: the docs cover editor comments (not reader comments on a site) and billing credit cards (not taking payments on a site). Candidates the docs did answer were dropped: on-premises installs (answered: SaaS only) and Kubernetes (answered: AKS deployment). Second batch (109-115), written 2026-10-15 and committed before scoring, checked the same way against all 4,933 sections of agility-docs-production. Near-misses: HIPAA (the docs list SOC 2 and Azure certifications only), watermarks (image transformations exist, no watermark or overlay), right-to-left languages (locales are covered, text direction is not), email on your own domain (custom asset domains and DNS are covered, email is not), recurring publishing (one-off scheduling and a weekly team cadence are covered, repeating schedules are not). Dropped because the docs answer them: importing a Word document (paste from Word), cancelling a subscription (contact support), password-protecting pages (member portal and Auth0 guides), tracking product inventory (headless commerce reference architecture), Salesforce Marketing Cloud (webhooks page names Salesforce sync generically: too ambiguous), heatmaps (docs say analytics tools connect through apps: arguably an answer).
